chapter: Funerals, societies and the future of fiddling
title: Drums beaten at funerals
summary: Cage says drums were played at funerals, on the way to the cemetery and back.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: They used to beat drums when people died, too. When people died, they beat drums. Yeah, they're nothing.
Did they have anything besides drums when people died?
No, I don't think they did. Drums are the whole time standby.
How would they beat the drums? They would beat them on the way, taking them? Where would they beat the drums?
I beat them going to the cemetery and coming back.
